messages.subject: Example CFA/SEM write-ups
parts:
Hello,
I am using lavaan to for my SEM analysis. This is my first time using lavaan and R. I was wondering if there are any recommendations for readings that provides an example of the results write up for both the CFA portion of testing the measurement models and also the SEM of testing the full structural model. Thank you in advance!

Best,
Saundra

messages.author: bfa43814f6ba1969
messages.subject: Re: Example CFA/SEM write-ups
parts:
Hi,


I use this article as an empirical example:


Mesquita, L. F., & Lazzarini, S. G. (2008). Horizontal and Vertical Relationships in Developing Economies: Implications for SMEs’ Access to Global Markets. Academy of Management Journal, 51(2), 359–380.

Their original model has a specification error presumably because the SEM software defaults for certain parameters are zero, but if you ignore that the reporting is really great. They do a very clear model comparison table focusing on the chi2. (Note that the original misspecified model would pass if they followed the alternative fit indices) Table 4 contains a degrees of freedom calculation that allows understanding the model better. On top of that, they report the indicator covariance matrix that allows for full replication of all results.


Mikko
